_published_faq.name: How do I add GVRN Company Incorporation MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GVRN Company Incorporation MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://core-api.gvrn.ai/incorporation-mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is GVRN Company Incorporation MCP MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, GVRN Company Incorporation MCP scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GVRN Company Incorporation MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GVRN Company Incorporation MCP provides these MCP tools: create_incorporation_draft, get_incorporation_guide, get_incorporation_status, request_email_otp, submit_incorporation, update_incorporation_draft, and verify_email_otp.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GVRN Company Incorporation MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GVRN Company Incorporation MCP in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, CiteLaw, and CookieYes.

_published_faq.name: Does GVRN Company Incorporation MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: GVRN Company Incorporation MCP does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Who develops GVRN Company Incorporation MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: GVRN Company Incorporation MCP is developed by GVRN. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
